title: fix: stop rejecting every page-view beacon with 415
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Found while verifying the production deploy of #15149.

**Symptom:** `product_event` in `pollinations_enter` had 0 `page_viewed` rows, and every same-origin POST to `/api/analytics/page-view` returned 415 — including a raw HTTP POST with no `Content-Length` header at all.

**Cause:** `if (c.req.raw.body) return c.body(null, 415)`. At the Cloudflare edge every POST has a non-null body stream, so the guard rejected 100% of real beacons. It passed CI because a `Request` constructed inside workerd genuinely has a null body, so no test ever exercised the network path.

**Fix:** drop the guard. The handler reads `c.req.query()` and never touches the body, so it protected nothing. The test now asserts the opposite — a POST carrying a body is recorded.

Pre-existing since #14938; `TINYBIRD_ANALYTICS_ENABLED` short-circuited to 204 before reaching the check, so it only became reachable when the flag was removed.

Server-side events were never affected — `sign_in_started` rows are already arriving in production.

gist.headline: The beacons can land
gist.blurb: A tiny edge-case guard was treating every page-view beacon like suspicious pollen. It is gone now, and page visits can finally reach the garden ledger.
gist.summary: Fixed the `/api/analytics/page-view` handler so same-origin POST beacons with a body are recorded instead of being rejected with HTTP 415.
gist.impact: Page-view analytics can now populate `page_viewed` events in `pollinations_enter`, while existing server-side events continue as before.
